rationale: A campaign-level aggregate spend ceiling is a durable recovery control: it prevents retries or replacement executions from exceeding an approved budget. Its enclosing recovery_policy establishes that it constrains recovery decisions rather than being a per-run estimate or cap.
alternatives: Move to CampaignPlan if it caps all planned and recovery spend, not only recovery decisions.
Remove it if max_physical_executions_per_trial and per-run spend_cap_microusd are the only intended cost controls.
simplestChoice: Keep one optional non-negative integer aggregate cap in recovery_policy.
questions: Does this cap apply only to additional recovery executions, or to all campaign spend? If it applies to all spend, move it to CampaignPlan.
